8	/-!
9	# Upper semicontinuity of the point rank, without flatness
10	
11	**Campaign milestone B5, base-side half.**  For a finitely presented
12	quasi-coherent module `F` on a locally noetherian scheme `S`, the sublevel
13	locus of the fibre dimension
14	
15	```
16	{s : S | pointRank S F s ≤ e}
17	```
18	
19	is **open**, with no flatness hypothesis anywhere.
20	
21	## Why this is not the existing statement
22	
23	`Picard/FlatteningStratificationUniversal.lean` already carries
24	`Scheme.Modules.isOpen_pointRank_pullback_eq`, and the two must not be
25	conflated:
26	
27	* that theorem needs `Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat (𝟙 T)` on the pullback and
28	  concludes that the locus where the rank *equals* `e` is open — it is local
29	  constancy of the rank of a *flat* finitely presented module, geometrized;
30	* this one has **no flatness hypothesis** and concludes openness of the
31	  `≤ e` sublevel set.  Without flatness the rank genuinely jumps, so the
32	  equality loci are *not* open and only the sublevel direction survives.
33	  That is exactly the semicontinuity B5 asks for.
34	
35	Neither implies the other: drop flatness from the first and it is false;
36	strengthen `≤ e` to `= e` here and it is false.
37	
38	## The proof, and what it consumes
39	
40	The locus is exactly the union `⋃ i ≤ e, chartLocus F i`, and
41	`Scheme.Modules.chartLocus` is by construction an `S.Opens` (a supremum of
42	affine opens), so openness is structural rather than earned:
43	
44	* `⊆` is the **Nakayama prolongation**
45	  `Scheme.Modules.exists_presentationChart_mem`, packaged as
46	  `Scheme.Modules.mem_chartLocus_of_pointRank_eq`: a point of fibre dimension
47	  `i` has an affine neighbourhood carrying an `i`-generator matrix
48	  presentation.  Applied at `i := pointRank S F s`, which is `≤ e` by
49	  hypothesis;
50	* `⊇` is `Scheme.Modules.pointRank_le_of_mem_chartLocus` (an `i`-generator
51	  presentation bounds every fibre dimension in its chart by `i`), composed
52	  with `i ≤ e`.
53	
54	So the mathematical content was already in the tree; what was missing was the
55	observation that the *union over `i ≤ e`* is the sublevel set.  No
56	monotonicity of `IsPresentationChart` in the generator count is needed — a
57	point contributes at its own rank, not at `e`.
58	
59	## Scope, stated exactly
60	
61	This is the **base-side** half of B5.  It is a statement about a module on
62	`S` and its fibre dimensions, and it is unconditional in the sense that
63	matters: no flatness, no `h¹`-vanishing, no properness.
64	
65	It is **not** by itself `Scheme.HasH0Semicontinuity`
66	(`Picard/SemicontinuityH0.lean`), whose `h⁰` is the dimension of the global
67	sections of `L` on the scheme-theoretic *fibre curve* `C_t`, not the fibre
68	dimension of a module on the base.  Bridging the two needs the pushforward
69	`q_* L` to be finitely presented on the base and its fibre dimension to agree
70	with `q.fiberH0 L t` — and the landed bridge for that agreement,
71	`AlgebraicGeometry.rank_pushforward_eq_fiberH0`
72	(`Picard/RigidPushforwardRank.lean`), carries a `Module.Projective`
73	hypothesis which is *load-bearing* (a counterexample is recorded at
74	`Picard/RigidPushforwardP1Sheaf.lean`:567-576) and which forces `h⁰` to be
75	locally *constant*.  So that bridge cannot serve semicontinuity; see the
76	inbox issue filed by `ajc-p4` for the measurement.
77	
78	## References
79	
80	Nitsure, *Construction of Hilbert and Quot schemes*, §4 (the local
81	`e`-generator presentation and its chart).  Hartshorne III 12.8; Mumford,
82	*Abelian Varieties*, II §5.
83	-/
84	
85	set_option autoImplicit false
86	
87	universe u
88	
89	open CategoryTheory Module
90	
91	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
92	
93	namespace Scheme
94	
95	namespace Modules
96	
97	/-- **B5, base-side: the point-rank sublevel locus is open**, with no
98	flatness hypothesis.
99	
100	For a finitely presented quasi-coherent `F` on a locally noetherian `S`, the
101	set of points whose fibre dimension is at most `e` is open.  Contrast
102	`isOpen_pointRank_pullback_eq`, which assumes flatness and gets openness of
103	the *equality* locus; without flatness only this sublevel direction is true.
104	
105	The locus is `⋃ i ≤ e, chartLocus F i`: a point of rank `i ≤ e` lies in
106	`chartLocus F i` by the Nakayama prolongation, and every point of
107	`chartLocus F i` has rank `≤ i ≤ e`. -/
108	theorem isOpen_pointRank_le {S : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (F : S.Modules)
109	    [F.IsFinitePresentation] [F.IsQuasicoherent] (e : ℕ) :
110	    IsOpen {s : S | pointRank S F s ≤ e} := by
111	  have hset : {s : S | pointRank S F s ≤ e}
112	      = ⋃ i ∈ Finset.range (e + 1), ((chartLocus F i : S.Opens) : Set S) := by
113	    ext s
114	    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iUnion, Finset.mem_range]
115	    constructor
116	    · intro hs
117	      exact ⟨pointRank S F s, by omega, mem_chartLocus_of_pointRank_eq F _ rfl⟩
118	    · rintro ⟨i, hie, hmem⟩
119	      exact le_trans (pointRank_le_of_mem_chartLocus F i hmem) (by omega)
120	  rw [hset]
121	  exact isOpen_biUnion fun i _ => (chartLocus F i).isOpen
122	
123	/-- **B5, base-side, closed form**: the superlevel locus of the point rank is
124	closed.  This is the direction milestone B6 consumes (closedness of a
125	triviality locus), obtained as the set-theoretic complement — the `ℕ`-valued
126	rank makes `e + 1 ≤ r` and `¬ (r ≤ e)` the same condition. -/
127	theorem isClosed_le_pointRank {S : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (F : S.Modules)
128	    [F.IsFinitePresentation] [F.IsQuasicoherent] (e : ℕ) :
129	    IsClosed {s : S | e + 1 ≤ pointRank S F s} := by
130	  have hcompl : {s : S | e + 1 ≤ pointRank S F s}
131	      = {s : S | pointRank S F s ≤ e}ᶜ := by
132	    ext s
133	    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_compl_iff, not_le]
134	    omega
135	  rw [hcompl]
136	  exact (isOpen_pointRank_le F e).isClosed_compl
137	
138	end Modules
139	
140	end Scheme
141	
142	end AlgebraicGeometry

8	/-!
9	# The fibre `h⁰` comparison, without projectivity
10	
11	**The bridge B5 needs, and the one `rank_pushforward_eq_fiberH0` cannot give.**
12	
13	`AlgebraicGeometry.rank_pushforward_eq_fiberH0` (`Picard/RigidPushforwardRank.lean`)
14	proves `sectionsRankAtStalk (p_* M) t = p.fiberH0 M t` under three hypotheses
15	`hfin`, `hproj`, `hbc`.  Its own module docstring establishes that `hproj`
16	(`Module.Projective` of the Čech `H⁰`) is **load-bearing**: dropped, the
17	statement is false, with the counterexample `A = k[x]`,
18	`M = 𝒪_{ℙ¹_A}/x` recorded at `Picard/RigidPushforwardP1Sheaf.lean`:567-576.
19	
20	That is true of *that* statement, and it has been read as a bound on what the
21	machinery can deliver.  It is not.  Reading which step consumes which
22	hypothesis shows `hfin` and `hproj` are used **only in step 1**, the appeal to
23	`Module.rankAtStalk_eq` that converts `sectionsRankAtStalk` — a
24	`Module.rankAtStalk`, which is a statement about the module being flat — into a
25	fibre dimension.  Steps 2 through 6, the entire semilinear transport
26	
27	```
28	κ(t)-fibre of Γ(p_* M, ⊤)  ≅  κ(t) ⊗ ker d  ≅  ker (d ⊗ κ(t))
29	                           ≅  ker d_t       ≅  Γ(X_t, M_t)
30	```
31	
32	consume **neither `hfin` nor `hproj`** — verified by a fresh-context review,
33	which reproduced the original from this theorem by adding only
34	`Module.rankAtStalk_eq`.  So this file states the comparison with those two
35	hypotheses removed:
36	
37	* `fiberRank_gammaTop_eq_fiberH0` — no `hfin`, no `hproj`, only `hbc`.
38	
39	**But dropping `hfin` has a cost, and it must be stated here rather than
40	discovered later.**  The original's docstring
41	(`Picard/RigidPushforwardRank.lean`:138-145) closes a junk-value hazard:
42	`Module.finrank` returns `0` in the infinite-dimensional case, on *both* sides,
43	so the identity could hold vacuously as `0 = 0`.  Its argument that this cannot
44	happen runs entirely through `hfin` (`ker d` finite ⟹ `κ(t) ⊗ ker d` is
45	finite-dimensional ⟹ steps 3-6 carry that to `Γ(X_t, M_t)`).  `hbc` does **not**
46	replace it: taking `d = 0 : M₀ →ₗ[A] PUnit` makes `hbc` hold for every `B`
47	(trivially surjective) with `ker d = M₀` arbitrary, so an infinite-dimensional
48	`ker d` is compatible with `hbc` and both sides then read `0`.
49	
50	So the theorem below is honest but weaker than the original in a way the
51	hypothesis list alone does not show: **it is informative only where `ker d` is
52	finite-dimensional over `κ(t)`**, and it does not certify that itself.  A
53	consumer wanting a non-vacuous reading must supply finite-dimensionality
54	separately — which is *not* the same as supplying `hfin` (`Module.Finite` over
55	the base), and is the reason the statement is still worth having.
56	
57	## What this buys for B5, and the obligation it does NOT remove
58	
59	`Scheme.HasH0Semicontinuity` (`Picard/SemicontinuityH0.lean`) asks for openness
60	of `{t | q.fiberH0 L t ≤ n}`.  The `sectionsRankAtStalk` form cannot be an input
61	to it: semicontinuity is only informative where the fibre dimension *jumps*, and
62	`hproj` forces it locally constant (`Module.isLocallyConstant_rankAtStalk`).
63	The `Ideal.fiberRank` form here has no such effect, which is the point of the
64	restatement.
65	
66	**It does not, however, already match
67	`Scheme.Modules.isOpen_pointRank_le`** (`Picard/PointRankSemicontinuity.lean`),
68	and an earlier revision of this docstring claimed it did.  Measured: the two are
69	*not the same term* and `rfl` between them fails.  `pointRank` unfolds (through
70	`pointRank_eq_chartFiberRank` at `V = ⊤`) to a `fiberRank` taken at a prime of
71	`Γ(Spec R, ⊤)` with the `Γ(Spec R, ⊤)`-module structure, whereas the conclusion
72	below uses `t.asIdeal` for `t : PrimeSpectrum R` with the `R`-module structure.
73	Bridging them needs a `ΓSpecIso` transport of exactly the kind steps 2 and 6
74	perform by hand, and the only in-tree lemma relating the two worlds,
75	`Scheme.Modules.rankAtStalk_sections_eq_pointRank`
76	(`Picard/FlatteningStratificationUniversal.lean`:204), carries
77	`[Module.Flat]` + `[Module.Finite]` binders — i.e. precisely what was dropped.
78	
79	So B5 has **three** open obligations, not one: (a) `hbc` without
80	`h¹`-vanishing, (b) finite-dimensionality to defeat the junk-value reading, and
81	(c) this carrier bridge between `pointRank` and `Ideal.fiberRank`.  (c) was
82	unlisted until a fresh-context review found it.
83	
84	## What is still open
85	
86	The remaining hypothesis `hbc` — bijectivity of
87	`AlgebraicJacobian.TwoTerm.kerBaseChange` over every algebra — is *not* free,
88	and it is worth being precise about why, because the temptation is to hope it
89	falls out of flatness.
90	
91	Its only producer in the tree,
92	`TwoTerm.bijective_kerBaseChange_of_surjective`, needs `d` **surjective** —
93	i.e. `h¹`-vanishing.  Surjectivity is genuinely necessary and not an artefact
94	of that proof: take `A = ℤ`, `d = (2 · ·) : ℤ → ℤ`, which is injective with
95	both terms flat but not surjective.  Then `ker d = 0`, so `B ⊗ ker d = 0` for
96	every `B`, while over `B = ℤ/2` the base-changed map is zero and
97	`ker (d ⊗ B) = ℤ/2 ≠ 0`.  So `kerBaseChange` is not bijective, with flatness
98	of both terms intact.
99	
100	What this file therefore does is **relocate** part of the B5 obligation, not
101	discharge it.  It converts "find a projectivity-free rank bridge" — impossible,
102	and the route the gate's own docstring prescribes — into the three named items
103	(a), (b), (c) above, of which (a) is the honest half of
104	cohomology-and-base-change (Stacks 02KG).  Correctly located; all three open.
105	
106	One route not yet followed: a `TwoTermFiniteReplacement` supplies
107	`h0_bijective` for *every* algebra `B` with **no** surjectivity hypothesis
108	(it is a field of the structure, and `exists_twoTermFiniteReplacement` needs
109	only noetherian + flat + f.g. cohomology).  That is a comparison between the
110	`H⁰`s of the replacement and original complexes rather than the
111	`kerBaseChange` of one map, so it does not immediately give `hbc`; whether it
112	can be made to is the next thing to try.
113	
114	## References
115	
116	Stacks 02KG (cohomology and base change at `i = 0`), 00NX; Mumford,
117	*Abelian Varieties*, II §5; Hartshorne III 12.8, 12.11.
118	-/

128	variable {R : CommRingCat.{u}} {X : Scheme.{u}}
129	
130	/-- **The fibre-`h⁰` comparison, with no projectivity and no finiteness.**
131	
132	For quasi-compact quasi-separated `p : X ⟶ Spec R`, quasi-coherent `M` carrying
133	a two-chart affine cover `𝒰`, and `t : Spec R` with affine fibre inclusion, the
134	`κ(t)`-fibre dimension of the base section module `Γ(p_* M, ⊤)` equals the
135	fibre `h⁰`, assuming only the base-change bijectivity `hbc`.
136	
137	This is steps 2-6 of `rank_pushforward_eq_fiberH0` with step 1 — the only step
138	that consumes `hfin`/`hproj` — removed, and the conclusion restated on
139	`Ideal.fiberRank` rather than on `sectionsRankAtStalk`.  See the module
140	docstring for why that restatement is what milestone B5 needs. -/
141	theorem fiberRank_gammaTop_eq_fiberH0
142	    (p : X ⟶ Spec R) (𝒰 : X.AffineCoverMVSquare) (M : X.Modules)
143	    [M.IsQuasicoherent] [QuasiCompact p] [QuasiSeparated p]
144	    (t : PrimeSpectrum R) [IsAffineHom (p.fiberι t)]
145	    (hbc :
146	      letI := p.baseSectionsModule M 𝒰.U₁
147	      letI := p.baseSectionsModule M 𝒰.U₂
148	      letI := p.baseSectionsModule M (𝒰.U₁ ⊓ 𝒰.U₂)
149	      ∀ (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra Γ(Spec R, ⊤) B],
150	        Function.Bijective (AlgebraicJacobian.TwoTerm.kerBaseChange
151	          (𝒰.moduleSectionDiffBase p M) B)) :
152	    Module.finrank t.asIdeal.ResidueField
153	        (t.asIdeal.Fiber Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).obj M, (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens)))
154	      = p.fiberH0 M t := by
155	  letI m1 := p.baseSectionsModule M 𝒰.U₁
156	  letI m2 := p.baseSectionsModule M 𝒰.U₂
157	  letI m0 := p.baseSectionsModule M (𝒰.U₁ ⊓ 𝒰.U₂)
158	  letI mT := p.baseSectionsModule M (⊤ : X.Opens)
159	  letI n1 := (p.fiberToSpecResidueField t).baseSectionsModule (p.fiberModule t M)
160	    ((𝒰.preimage (p.fiberι t)).U₁)
161	  letI n2 := (p.fiberToSpecResidueField t).baseSectionsModule (p.fiberModule t M)
162	    ((𝒰.preimage (p.fiberι t)).U₂)
163	  letI n0 := (p.fiberToSpecResidueField t).baseSectionsModule (p.fiberModule t M)
164	    ((𝒰.preimage (p.fiberι t)).U₁ ⊓ (𝒰.preimage (p.fiberι t)).U₂)
165	  letI nT := (p.fiberToSpecResidueField t).baseSectionsModule (p.fiberModule t M)
166	    (⊤ : (p.fiber t).Opens)
167	  letI aRK : Algebra Γ(Spec R, ⊤) Γ(Spec ((Spec R).residueField t), ⊤) :=
168	    (((Spec R).fromSpecResidueField t).appLE ⊤ ⊤ le_top).hom.toAlgebra
169	  have e0 : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).obj M, (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))
170	      ≃ₗ[Γ(Spec R, ⊤)] LinearMap.ker (𝒰.moduleSectionDiffBase p M) :=
171	    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardTopEquivBaseSections p M) ≪≫ₗ
172	      (𝒰.globalSectionsEquivKerModuleSectionDiffBase p M)
173	  -- STEP 2 (unconditional)
174	  have step2 : Module.finrank t.asIdeal.ResidueField
175	        (t.asIdeal.Fiber Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).obj M, (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens)))
176	      = Module.finrank Γ(Spec ((Spec R).residueField t), ⊤)
177	          (TensorProduct Γ(Spec R, ⊤) Γ(Spec ((Spec R).residueField t), ⊤)
178	            (LinearMap.ker (𝒰.moduleSectionDiffBase p M))) := by
179	    refine finrank_tensor_eq_of_ringEquiv
180	      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.symm
181	      (specResidueFieldRingEquiv R t) ?_ e0.toAddEquiv ?_
182	    · intro r
183	      have h := appLE_fromSpecResidueField_apply R t
184	        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.symm r)
185	      rw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
186	      exact h.symm
187	    · intro r n
188	      rw [smul_gammaSpecTop ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).obj M) r n]
189	      exact e0.map_smul _ _
190	  have hbcK := hbc Γ(Spec ((Spec R).residueField t), ⊤)
191	  have step3 : Module.finrank Γ(Spec ((Spec R).residueField t), ⊤)
192	        (TensorProduct Γ(Spec R, ⊤) Γ(Spec ((Spec R).residueField t), ⊤)
193	          (LinearMap.ker (𝒰.moduleSectionDiffBase p M)))
194	      = Module.finrank Γ(Spec ((Spec R).residueField t), ⊤)
195	          (LinearMap.ker (((𝒰.moduleSectionDiffBase p M).baseChange
196	            Γ(Spec ((Spec R).residueField t), ⊤)))) :=
197	    LinearEquiv.finrank_eq (LinearEquiv.ofBijective _ hbcK)
198	  have step4 := finrank_ker_baseChange_residueField 𝒰 p M t
199	  have step5 : Module.finrank Γ(Spec ((Spec R).residueField t), ⊤)
200	        (LinearMap.ker ((𝒰.preimage (p.fiberι t)).moduleSectionDiffBase
201	          (p.fiberToSpecResidueField t) (p.fiberModule t M)))
202	      = Module.finrank Γ(Spec ((Spec R).residueField t), ⊤)
203	          Γ(p.fiberModule t M, (⊤ : (p.fiber t).Opens)) :=
204	    (LinearEquiv.finrank_eq ((𝒰.preimage (p.fiberι t)).globalSectionsEquivKerModuleSectionDiffBase
205	      (p.fiberToSpecResidueField t) (p.fiberModule t M))).symm
206	  have step6 : Module.finrank Γ(Spec ((Spec R).residueField t), ⊤)
207	        Γ(p.fiberModule t M, (⊤ : (p.fiber t).Opens))
208	      = p.fiberH0 M t := by
209	    letI := p.fiberSectionsModule t (p.fiberModule t M)
210	    refine finrank_eq_of_ringEquiv_addEquiv
211	      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso ((Spec R).residueField t)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
212	      (AddEquiv.refl _) ?_
213	    intro r m
214	    change r • m = _
215	    rw [Scheme.Hom.baseSectionsModule_smul_def]
216	    change _ = ((p.fiberResidueMap t).hom
217	      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso ((Spec R).residueField t)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv r)) • m
218	    congr 1
219	    simp only [Scheme.Hom.fiberResidueMap, CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply]
220	    have hLE : (p.fiberToSpecResidueField t).appLE ⊤ ⊤ le_top
221	        = (p.fiberToSpecResidueField t).appTop := Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app _
222	    rw [hLE]
223	    congr 1
224	    have h1 := congrArg (fun φ : Γ(Spec ((Spec R).residueField t), ⊤) ⟶
225	        Γ(Spec ((Spec R).residueField t), ⊤) => φ.hom r)
226	      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso ((Spec R).residueField t)).hom_inv_id
227	    simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply, CommRingCat.hom_id,
228	      RingHom.id_apply] at h1
229	    exact h1.symm
230	  rw [step2, step3, step4, step5, step6]
231	
232	end AlgebraicGeometry

/-- The **fiber rank** of a module `M` at a prime `p`: the dimension of the
fiber `κ(p) ⊗[R] M` over the residue field `κ(p)`.  [Nitsure §4:
`e = dim_{κ(s)} F|_s`.] -/
noncomputable def fiberRank (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime]
    (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] : ℕ :=
  Module.finrank p.ResidueField (p.Fiber M)

end Ideal

variable {e m : ℕ}

/-- **Point-set description of the rank-`e` stratum** [Nitsure §4, part (i)
of the theorem, `n = 0` case]: a prime `p` contains the entry ideal of an
`e`-generator presentation iff the fiber of `M` at `p` has dimension
exactly `e`. -/
theorem entryIdeal_le_prime_iff (P : MatrixPresentation R M e m)
    (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] :
    P.entryIdeal ≤ p ↔ p.fiberRank M = e := by
  have hker : RingHom.ker (algebraMap R p.ResidueField) = p :=
    Ideal.ker_algebraMap_residueField p
  constructor
  · -- entries in `p` ⟹ the fiber presentation has zero relation matrix
    intro hle
    have h0 : (P.baseChange p.ResidueField).relMatrix = 0 := by
      rw [baseChange_relMatrix, relMatrix_map_eq_zero_iff, hker]
      exact hle
    rw [Ideal.fiberRank, ← LinearEquiv.finrank_eq
      ((P.baseChange p.ResidueField).projEquiv h0)]

    -- direction over the residue field), so the entries lie in `p`
    intro hrank
    have h0 : (P.baseChange p.ResidueField).relMatrix = 0 := by
      refine (P.baseChange p.ResidueField).relMatrix_eq_zero_of_flat ?_
      intro q
      rw [Module.rankAtStalk_eq_finrank_of_free]
      exact hrank
    rw [baseChange_relMatrix, relMatrix_map_eq_zero_iff, hker] at h0
    exact h0

@[simp] lemma matrixPresentationBasicOpen_relMatrix {e mm : ℕ}
    {V : X.affineOpens} (P : MatrixPresentation Γ(X, V.1) Γ(G, V.1) e mm)
    (f : Γ(X, V.1)) :
    (MatrixPresentationBasicOpen G P f).relMatrix =
      P.relMatrix.map (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op).hom :=
  rfl

/-- Presentation charts are stable under passing to basic opens. -/
theorem IsPresentationChart.basicOpen {e : ℕ} {V : X.affineOpens}
    (h : IsPresentationChart G e V) (f : Γ(X, V.1)) :
    IsPresentationChart G e (X.affineBasicOpen f) := by
  obtain ⟨mm, ⟨P⟩⟩ := h
  exact ⟨mm, ⟨MatrixPresentationBasicOpen G P f⟩⟩

/-- The dimension of the fiber of `G` at a point `x` of an affine open
chart `V`: the fiber rank of the section module `Γ(G, V)` at the prime of
`x` [Nitsure §4: `e = dim_{κ(s)} F(s)`]. -/
noncomputable def chartFiberRank {V : X.affineOpens} (x : X)
    (hx : x ∈ V.1) : ℕ :=
  ((V.2.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩).asIdeal).fiberRank Γ(G, V.1)

omit [SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent G] in
lemma chartFiberRank_congr_chart {V W : X.affineOpens} (h : V = W) (x : X)
    (hxV : x ∈ V.1) (hxW : x ∈ W.1) :
    chartFiberRank G x hxV = chartFiberRank G x hxW := by
  subst h; rfl

/-- The chart fiber rank is unchanged by passing to a basic open of the
chart. -/
theorem chartFiberRank_basicOpen {V : X.affineOpens} (f : Γ(X, V.1))
    (x : X) (hx : x ∈ X.basicOpen f) :
    chartFiberRank G (V := V) x (X.basicOpen_le f hx) =
      chartFiberRank G (V := X.affineBasicOpen f) x hx := by
  haveI := V.2.isLocalization_basicOpen f
  haveI := Scheme.Modules.isLocalizedModule_basicOpen G V.2 f
  have hloc := Ideal.fiberRank_of_isLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f)
    (restrictBasicOpenₗ G f)
    (((V.2.basicOpen f).primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩).asIdeal)
  have hle : X.basicOpen f ≤ (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X) ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 := X.basicOpen_le f
  have h1 := IsAffineOpen.comap_primeIdealOf_appLE (f := (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X))
    V.1 V.2 (X.basicOpen f) (V.2.basicOpen f) hle hx
  rw [Scheme.id_appLE] at h1
  have hpt : V.2.primeIdealOf ⟨(𝟙 X : X ⟶ X) x, hle hx⟩ =
      V.2.primeIdealOf ⟨x, X.basicOpen_le f hx⟩ := by
    congr 1
  have hcomap :
      (((V.2.basicOpen f).primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩).asIdeal).comap
          (algebraMap Γ(X, V.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f)) =
        (V.2.primeIdealOf ⟨x, X.basicOpen_le f hx⟩).asIdeal := by
    have h2 : algebraMap Γ(X, V.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) =
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op).hom := rfl
    rw [h2, ← hpt]
    exact congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal h1
  calc chartFiberRank G (V := V) x (X.basicOpen_le f hx)
      = ((((V.2.basicOpen f).primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩).asIdeal).comap
          (algebraMap Γ(X, V.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f))).fiberRank Γ(G, V.1) :=
        Ideal.fiberRank_congr_ideal hcomap.symm
    _ = (((V.2.basicOpen f).primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩).asIdeal).fiberRank
          Γ(G, X.basicOpen f) := hloc.symm
    _ = chartFiberRank G (V := X.affineBasicOpen f) x hx := rfl

/-- **Chart-independence of the fiber rank**: two affine charts through the
same point give the same fiber rank.  Proof: refine to a common basic open
(`exists_basicOpen_le_affine_inter`) and localize both sides. -/
theorem chartFiberRank_eq {V W : X.affineOpens} (x : X)
    (hxV : x ∈ V.1) (hxW : x ∈ W.1) :
    chartFiberRank G x hxV = chartFiberRank G x hxW := by
  obtain ⟨f, g, hfg, hxf⟩ :=
    exists_basicOpen_le_affine_inter V.2 W.2 x ⟨hxV, hxW⟩
  have hxg : x ∈ X.basicOpen g := by rw [← hfg]; exact hxf
  have h1 := chartFiberRank_basicOpen G (V := V) f x hxf
  have h2 := chartFiberRank_basicOpen G (V := W) g x hxg
  have h3 : chartFiberRank G (V := X.affineBasicOpen f) x hxf =
      chartFiberRank G (V := X.affineBasicOpen g) x hxg :=
    chartFiberRank_congr_chart G (Subtype.ext hfg) x hxf hxg
  calc chartFiberRank G x hxV
      = chartFiberRank G (V := V) x (X.basicOpen_le f hxf) := rfl
    _ = chartFiberRank G (V := X.affineBasicOpen f) x hxf := h1
    _ = chartFiberRank G (V := X.affineBasicOpen g) x hxg := h3
    _ = chartFiberRank G (V := W) x (X.basicOpen_le g hxg) := h2.symm
    _ = chartFiberRank G x hxW := rfl

variable (X) in
/-- The **point rank** of a quasi-coherent module: the dimension of its
fiber at the point, computed through any affine chart
(`pointRank_eq_chartFiberRank`). -/
noncomputable def pointRank (x : X) : ℕ :=
  chartFiberRank G x (V := ⟨(exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset
      (x := x) (U := ⊤) trivial).choose,
      (exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := x) (U := ⊤)
        trivial).choose_spec.1⟩)
    (exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := x) (U := ⊤)
      trivial).choose_spec.2.1

theorem pointRank_eq_chartFiberRank {V : X.affineOpens} (x : X)
    (hx : x ∈ V.1) : pointRank X G x = chartFiberRank G x hx :=
  chartFiberRank_eq G x _ hx

/-- **Nakayama prolongation of a fiber basis** [Nitsure §4, `n = 0` case,
first step]: for `M` finitely presented over `R` and `p` a prime, there is
`g ∉ p` such that every localization `(R', N)` of `(R, M)` away from `g`
admits a matrix presentation with exactly `e = fiberRank p M` generators.

The statement quantifies over abstract localizations (`IsLocalization.Away`
/ `IsLocalizedModule`) so that geometric section rings `Γ(S, D(g))` and
section modules `Γ(F, D(g))` can be consumed directly. -/
theorem exists_matrixPresentation_of_isLocalizedModule
    [Module.FinitePresentation R M] (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] :
    ∃ g : R, g ∉ p ∧
      ∀ (R' : Type u') [CommRing R'] [Algebra R R'] [IsLocalization.Away g R']
        (N : Type v') [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module R' N]
        [IsScalarTower R R' N] (l : M →ₗ[R] N)
        [IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers g) l],
      ∃ mm : ℕ, Nonempty (MatrixPresentation R' N (p.fiberRank M) mm) := by
  classical
  -- a basis of the fiber, rescaled to consist of pure tensors `1 ⊗ mᵢ`
  let b : Basis (Fin (p.fiberRank M)) p.ResidueField (p.Fiber M) :=
    Module.finBasis p.ResidueField (p.Fiber M)
  have hb : ∀ i, ∃ r ∉ p, ∃ s : M, r • b i = (1 : p.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[R] s := fun i ↦
    exists_smul_eq_one_tmul p (b i)
  choose r hr mvec hm using hb
  -- the images `1 ⊗ mᵢ` span the fiber
  have hunit : ∀ i, IsUnit (algebraMap R p.ResidueField (r i)) := by
    intro i
    rw [isUnit_iff_ne_zero, Ne, Ideal.algebraMap_residueField_eq_zero]
    exact hr i
  have hspan : Submodule.span p.ResidueField
      (Set.range fun i ↦ (1 : p.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[R] mvec i) = ⊤ := by
    have hsm : Set.range (fun i ↦ (1 : p.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[R] mvec i) =
        Set.range ⇑(b.unitsSMul fun i ↦ (hunit i).unit) := by
      apply congrArg
      funext i
      rw [← hm i, ← algebraMap_smul p.ResidueField (r i) (b i),
        Basis.unitsSMul_apply, Units.smul_def, IsUnit.unit_spec]
    rw [hsm]
    exact (b.unitsSMul fun i ↦ (hunit i).unit).span_eq
  -- the `mᵢ` generate `M` modulo Nakayama: the quotient has vanishing fiber
  have hQfiber : Subsingleton (p.ResidueField ⊗[R]
      (M ⧸ LinearMap.range (Fintype.linearCombination R mvec))) := by
    have hsurj : Function.Surjective
        ((LinearMap.range (Fintype.linearCombination R mvec)).mkQ.baseChange
          p.ResidueField) := by
      rw [LinearMap.baseChange_eq_ltensor]
      exact LinearMap.lTensor_surjective _ (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _)
    have hcomp : ((LinearMap.range (Fintype.linearCombination R mvec)).mkQ.baseChange
        p.ResidueField) ∘ₗ
        ((Fintype.linearCombination R mvec).baseChange p.ResidueField) = 0 := by
      rw [← LinearMap.baseChange_comp]
      have h0 : (LinearMap.range (Fintype.linearCombination R mvec)).mkQ ∘ₗ
          Fintype.linearCombination R mvec = 0 := by
        ext x
        simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply,
          Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
        exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
      rw [h0, LinearMap.baseChange_zero]
    have hrange : LinearMap.range
        ((Fintype.linearCombination R mvec).baseChange p.ResidueField) = ⊤ := by
      rw [← top_le_iff, ← hspan, Submodule.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨(1 : p.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ Pi.single i 1, by
        simp [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, Fintype.linearCombination_apply_single]⟩
    apply subsingleton_of_forall_eq 0
    intro x
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hsurj x
    have hy : y ∈ LinearMap.range
        ((Fintype.linearCombination R mvec).baseChange p.ResidueField) :=
      hrange ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact congr($hcomp a)
  -- Nakayama at `p`: the finite quotient localizes to zero at `p`

import Mathlib

open Module

/- Core arithmetic identity of the route: for a linear map d : V → W of
   finite-dimensional spaces over a field, dim ker d = dim V - dim range d,
   and dim coker d = dim W - dim range d.  So
     dim ker d = dim V - dim W + dim coker d.
   Since dim coker is upper semicontinuous (it is the fibre rank of a f.p.
   module = coker of the base-changed matrix), and dim V, dim W are CONSTANT
   for a FREE two-term complex, this gives upper semicontinuity of dim ker. -/
example {K : Type} [Field K] {V W : Type} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (d : V →ₗ[K] W) :
    finrank K (LinearMap.ker d) + finrank K W
      = finrank K V + finrank K (W ⧸ LinearMap.range d) := by
  have h1 : finrank K (LinearMap.range d) + finrank K (LinearMap.ker d) = finrank K V :=
    d.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  have h2 : finrank K (W ⧸ LinearMap.range d) + finrank K (LinearMap.range d) = finrank K W :=
    Submodule.finrank_quotient_add_finrank _
  omega
EOF
